# Eazipay vs SeamlessHR: Which Payroll Solution Is Right for Your Business in Nigeria?


- Oluwakemi Adesina


- November 8, 2026


Table of Contents


Toggle


Choosing the right payroll software can feel like navigating traffic in Lagos during rush hour, there are too many options, everyone is honking for your attention, and you just want to get to your destination without breaking down.


If you are trying to decide between Eazipay and SeamlessHR, you are likely looking for a tool that takes the stress out of paying salaries, calculating PAYE, and handling statutory deductions. But which one actually fits your team?


Honestly, it depends on what your business needs right now.


If your main goal is to run payroll in minutes, automate your tax and pension filings without stress, and keep your HR operations lean and straightforward, Eazipay is built right for you.


On the other hand, if you are running a large enterprise that needs deep HR modules like applicant tracking systems (ATS), shift rostering, and continuous performance appraisal tools, SeamlessHR is worth evaluating.


**Evaluating payroll solutions for your business?**


[Book a Demo with Eazipay](https://myeazipay.ng/business?scroll=true) today to see how automated payroll and statutory compliance can transform your operations.


##


**What Are Eazipay and SeamlessHR?**


Before checking feature details, let us look at what each platform was designed to do for Nigerian businesses.


[Eazipay](https://www.myeazipay.com/) is a dedicated payroll and HR solution built specifically to solve the payment and compliance bottlenecks Nigerian companies face every month.


Instead of forcing you through weeks of setup, Eazipay focuses on doing the heavy lifting where it matters most: calculating net pay accurately, executing direct bulk salary transfers to any Nigerian bank, and automatically filing PAYE taxes, Pension, NHF, NSITF, and ITF. It is fast, intuitive, and designed to let founders and HR teams handle payroll without needing a finance degree.


[SeamlessHR](https://seamlesshr.com/) is an enterprise HR management platform built to handle complex workforce structures across Africa.


It offers an all-in-one suite that connects payroll processing directly to broader enterprise HR functions. That means if your organization needs to manage recruitment pipelines, conduct 360-degree performance reviews, track shift rosters, and integrate with enterprise ERP systems like SAP or Oracle, SeamlessHR provides those extensive modules.


##


**Eazipay vs SeamlessHR: Feature-by-Feature Comparison**


Here is how both platforms compare across key business capabilities:


**Feature / Capability** **Eazipay** **SeamlessHR**


**Core Payroll Processing** Automated gross-to-net calculations, multi-tier approvals, bulk runs) Configurable pay structures, multi-cycle payroll runs)


**PAYE & Statutory Workflows** Direct filing and remittance for PAYE, Pension, NHF, NSITF, ITF Automated calculations, tax reports, and remittance workflows


**Bulk Salary Payments** Instant single-click disbursements across all Nigerian banks Direct bank disbursements and recurring payment tracking


**Employee Self-Service (ESS)** Web & mobile access for payslips, tax receipts, and leave requests Web portal, mobile app, and WhatsApp self-service


**HR & Employee Management** Employee records, leave tracking, onboarding, document management Full HR suite: ATS, performance appraisal, leave, time tracking


**Payroll Reports & Audit Trails** Automated cycle reports, complete audit logs, exportable tax receipts Custom reporting options and historical audit trails


**Integrations** Bank payment gateways, accounting software, HR data tools) ERP connectors for Microsoft, Sage, SAP, Oracle)


**Implementation Setup** Rapid setup; self-onboarding or guided setup within hours) Custom enterprise onboarding and team training)


**Pricing Model** Custom enterprise quote based on selected modules Custom enterprise quote based on selected modules


##


**Payroll Processing and Automation**


When it is 5:00 PM on payday, no HR manager wants to be stuck fixing formula errors on a massive spreadsheet. You want a system that processes payments cleanly and accurately.


1. **Day-to-Day Payroll Execution**


**With Eazipay:** The process is straightforward. You log in, update any variable allowances or one-off deductions for the month, preview the automatically computed gross-to-net figures, hit approve, and disburse salaries in a few clicks. It is designed to remove friction,[saving you hours](https://blog.myeazipay.com/2026/07/16/payroll-data-management-for-hr-professionals/) every pay period.


**With SeamlessHR:** The engine is built for multi-entity structures. If you have hundreds of staff spread across different legal entities, departments, and pay grades, SeamlessHR lets you set up multi-tiered approval chains to ensure every level of management signs off before funds move.


1. **Handling Exceptions**


Before choosing any tool, think about how often your business handles “payroll surprises” like mid-month hires needing prorated pay, sudden bonus payouts, or staff exiting mid-cycle. Eazipay lets you make instant adjustments directly from your dashboard, while SeamlessHR handles these adjustments through structured approval workflows.


1. **PAYE Calculations and Filing**


Eazipay handles statutory obligations end-to-end. It calculates your PAYE deductions; it actually files and remits payments directly to the respective State Internal Revenue Services. You get official government receipts right on your dashboard, keeping you fully audit-ready without visiting a tax office.


SeamlessHR calculates PAYE accurately according to Nigerian tax laws and generates clean schedules. Your finance team can then use these exportable reports to process filings through government portals.


1. **Pension and Multi-Agency Obligations**


Missing remittance deadlines leads to heavy fines. Eazipay routes pension contributions straight to your employees’ respective Pension Fund Administrators (PFAs) alongside your main salary run. SeamlessHR provides centralized compliance tracking to help enterprise finance leads monitor these obligations across large teams.


##


**Bulk Salary Payments and Operations**


Disbursing salaries across dozens of microfinance and commercial banks in Nigeria requires reliable payment channels.


**Bulk Payment Workflows:** Both platforms allow you to pay your entire staff directly from the system without exporting CSV files to upload on corporate banking sites.


**Handling Failed Transfers:** If an account number is wrong or a receiving bank network is down, Eazipay flags the specific failure immediately on your dashboard with clear diagnostic details, so you can retry that single transfer without delaying the rest of the company. SeamlessHR maintains enterprise-grade logs linked to system accounting modules to help finance teams reconcile bank statements.


##


**HR Features and Business Requirements**


Payroll is a huge piece of the puzzle, but what about the rest of your HR operations?


###


**Employee Self-Service**


Eazipay gives your employees a modern, self-service web and mobile portal. Staff can log in anytime to download their monthly payslips, view historical tax receipts, request leave, or update personal information saving your HR team from fielding endless repetitive emails.


SeamlessHR offers self-service across mobile apps and messaging channels like WhatsApp, making it easy for shift workers or field staff to pull up payslips on the go.


###


**Choosing the Right Tool for Your Scope**


**Choose Eazipay if:** You want a clean, powerful solution that[automates payroll](https://myeazipay.ng/for-business/payroll-management) , handles tax remittances easily, and keeps everyday HR admin simple.


**Choose SeamlessHR if:** Your enterprise needs an all-in-one HR ecosystem covering talent acquisition (ATS), shift rosters, and continuous performance evaluations.


##


**Pricing, Implementation, and Customer Support**


###


**How to Compare Total Cost**


When comparing software pricing, look at the big picture:


**Per-Employee Pricing vs. Custom Quotes:** Eazipay offers a transparent pricing structure where you pay per active employee seat, making it cost-effective as you scale. SeamlessHR typically builds custom enterprise quotes based on the specific module mix your company chooses.


**Setup Time:** Eazipay lets small and mid-sized businesses sign up and run their first live payroll in just a few hours. SeamlessHR implementations usually involve formal project management to configure enterprise workflows, which can take several weeks depending on company size.


##


**Which Provider Is Better for Your Business?**


Here is a simple framework to help you decide:


###


**1. Growing Businesses Prioritizing Payroll and Statutory Compliance**


If your biggest headache is getting salaries paid accurately on time, remitting taxes to state authorities, and keeping staff happy, Eazipay gives you a fast, dedicated platform that gets the job done without extra complexity.


###


**2. Enterprise Organizations Needing Full-Suite HR Management**


If you manage a workforce of hundreds of employees needing shift scheduling, applicant tracking for recruitment, and structured annual performance reviews in one place, SeamlessHR provides that extensive enterprise footprint.


###


**3. Teams Switching From Manual Spreadsheets**


If you are moving away from manual Excel templates, Eazipay’s short learning curve means your HR and finance leads can transition immediately without needing weeks of specialized software training.


##


**How to Switch Payroll Providers Safely**


Transitioning to a new payroll software does not have to be stressful. Follow this simple step-by-step migration checklist:


1. **Document Current Payroll Rules:** Gather all basic salary structures, allowances, relief claims, and employee PFA details.
2. **Clean Up Master Data:** Make sure employee Tax Identification Numbers (TIN), RSA Pension Pin numbers, and bank details are accurate.
3. **Set Up the New System:** Input your team’s salary components and tax rules into the new software.
4. **Run a Parallel Test:** Execute a test payroll run on your new software alongside your old method for one cycle to ensure numbers match 100%.
5. **Train Your Team:** Show your finance leads how to review reports and give employees access to their self-service portals.
6. **Go Live confidently:** Run your official payroll cycle and enjoy the time saved!


##


**Why Consider Eazipay?**


For Nigerian businesses looking for a fast, accurate, and completely compliant payroll solution, **Eazipay** takes away the monthly stress of salary runs and compliance.


1. **Complete Statutory Compliance:** Eazipay files and remits PAYE, Pension, NHF, and NSITF directly to relevant government agencies, giving you official state receipts.
2. **Single-Click Bulk Payments:** Pay your entire staff across all Nigerian banks instantly.
3. **Employee Self-Service:** Let employees download payslips and view tax records directly from their phones.
4. **Rapid Setup:** Get started immediately without waiting weeks for complex software implementations.


###


**Ready to Simplify Payroll and Compliance?**


Join thousands of Nigerian businesses that rely on Eazipay for fast payroll processing, automated tax filings, and error-free payments.


🔹[**Book a Demo](https://www.myeazipay.com/contact-sales) with Eazipay Today**


🔹[Explore Eazipay’s Payroll Management Solutions](https://myeazipay.ng/for-business/payroll-management)


##


**Frequently Asked Questions**


###


**1. What is the main difference between Eazipay and SeamlessHR?**


Eazipay is built specifically for fast, automated payroll processing, bulk salary disbursements, and direct statutory remittances (PAYE, Pension, NHF). SeamlessHR is an enterprise HR platform that combines payroll with broader modules like recruitment tracking, performance appraisals, and shift management.


###


**2. Which payroll software handles PAYE tax filings in Nigeria?**


Both tools calculate PAYE taxes according to Nigerian tax legislation. Eazipay goes a step further by automating the direct filing and remittance process to state internal revenue services, generating official state receipts on your dashboard.


###


**3. How can I compare pricing between Eazipay and SeamlessHR?**


Eazipay offers clear, flexible pricing per active employee seat. SeamlessHR provides custom enterprise quotes based on your headcount and the specific HR modules you choose.


###


**4. Which provider is best for a growing business in Nigeria?**


Growing businesses that want to run payroll quickly, automate tax compliance, and avoid lengthy software setup usually prefer Eazipay. Enterprise corporations with complex HR workflows across multiple branches may consider SeamlessHR.


###


**5. How long does it take to switch to Eazipay?**


Small to mid-sized businesses can set up their company account, upload employee data, and run their first live payroll on Eazipay within just a few hours.


###


**6. How do I book a demo with Eazipay?**


You can request a live product walkthrough by visiting the official[Eazipay Demo Page](https://myeazipay.ng/business?scroll=true) to speak directly with a payroll specialist.
